metric_definitions.answer_stability_rate: Repeated case groups whose factual required/forbidden marker outcome stayed stable.
metric_definitions.corrected_memory_preference_rate: Owner-corrected runs that used the approved marker and not rejected markers.
metric_definitions.evaluated_case_count: Number of unique dataset cases evaluated.
metric_definitions.failed_case_count: Unique cases with at least one failed repeat run.
metric_definitions.forbidden_style_rate: Runs containing prohibited technical or assistant-style phrasing.
metric_definitions.lack_of_evidence_correctness_rate: Lack-of-evidence runs that did not use forbidden facts.
metric_definitions.learned_memory_answer_support_rate: Learned indexed memory runs that used the required learned markers.
metric_definitions.over_refusal_rate: Grounded runs that answered with lack-of-evidence behavior despite expected support.
metric_definitions.passed_case_count: Unique cases whose every repeat run passed.
metric_definitions.persona_consistency_rate: Runs with persona_applied=true and no cold/technical forbidden style.
metric_definitions.perspective_preservation_rate: Perspective runs that preserved expected attribution behavior.
metric_definitions.profile_contamination_count: Runs where evidence contained markers forbidden for profile isolation.
metric_definitions.required_marker_rate: Runs where all required answer markers were present.
metric_definitions.retrieval_evidence_hit_rate: Grounded runs whose returned evidence matched required evidence markers or metadata.
metric_definitions.unsupported_detail_rate: Runs containing forbidden unsupported answer markers.
